newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia bonds, dollar flat on budget review.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia bonds, dollar flat on budget review.

text.p: The Australian dollar and bonds were basically flat in reponse to the government's release of the mid year review of the 1996/97 (July/June) budget.

In the budget review the government revised the forecast for the underlying deficit to A$8.49 billion from an original forecast of A$5.65 billion. The GDP growth forecast was left unchanged at 3.5 percent, while underlying inflation was revised down to 2.0 percent from 2.75 percent.
The unemployment rate forecast was revised up to 8.5 percent in the June quarter from an original forecast of 8.25 percent.
Both bonds and the dollar initially edged higher on the news, but then pulled back to be slightly under where they were trading before the review's release.
About half an hour after the review's release, the dollar was at US$0.7729/34 from a pre-release level of US$0.7732/37.
March 10-year bond futures were at 92.430 from a level of 92.440 just before the review's release.
